ID: `jado-ux-artifacts`.

## What it does

Edits the requested UX artifacts in the current context. Uses docs/ux in new projects, compatible formats and targeted verification.

## When to use it

Create or update a flow, journey, persona or story without a mandatory dossier.

## How to use it

Ask for it by name, or invoke it with `/jado-ux-artifacts` in Claude Code or `$jado-ux-artifacts` in Codex. Read the procedure from the JADO root and apply it only to the assigned outcome.

## What it delivers

- Canonical artifacts and relevant evidence
- Open decisions and stated limitations

## Example

Update recovery in the login flow.
